description: AI-generated client-facing content is marked or labelled as AI-generated/synthetic.
name: ai_content_marked

description: AI systems producing decisions or outputs are recorded in the firm's AI inventory.
name: ai_inventory_recorded

description: Every AI decision or output is recorded, with the model version that produced it, throughout the AI system lifecycle.
name: ai_outcomes_logged

description: Clients are informed when an AI system is generating client-facing responses or analysis.
name: ai_use_disclosed

description: Client consent is recorded where AI materially affects client rights, account access, or privacy.
name: consent_for_ai_decisions

description: Each AI output documents the decision-making logic and reasoning behind it (explainability).
name: decision_logic_recorded

description: Investor- or market-impacting AI outcomes carry evidence of human oversight or intervention.
name: human_oversight_evidenced

description: AI-related incidents are recorded with root-cause analysis and remediation actions.
name: incidents_root_caused

description: Public claims about the firm's AI are substantiated and not overstated (no 'AI-washing').
name: no_ai_washing

description: Every consequential action is traceable to a logged AI output that preceded it.
name: output_action_traceable

description: Reportable AI incidents are notified to the supervisory authority.
name: reportable_incident_notified
